questions.explanation: 上下文依据：前面提到这是旅行中来自陌生人的善意，无法回报，接下来作者说“很快我们在空间上就会变得遥远，并永远失去联系”。distant 意为“遥远的”，符合物理距离变远的语境。易错点：可能误选C(helpless)，但这里强调的是空间距离的拉大而非心理上的无助。
questions.supplement:
A(restless)：语境句：The audience grew restless as they waited for the delayed concert to begin. 固定搭配：grow restless, a restless night
B(active)：语境句：Staying physically active is essential for a healthy lifestyle. 固定搭配：stay active, an active role
C(helpless)：语境句：When her car broke down in the middle of nowhere, she felt completely helpless. 固定搭配：feel helpless, leave sb helpless
D(distant)：语境句：The sound of distant thunder warned us of the approaching storm. 固定搭配：a distant memory, distant relatives

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这是一种“没有过去，很可能也没有未来”的相遇（陌生人之间的偶遇）。encounter 意为“相遇，邂逅”，最符合语境。易错点：可能误选B(assumption)，但此处描述的是真实的经历而非假设。
questions.supplement:
A(encounter)：语境句：Their unexpected encounter in the coffee shop led to a lifelong friendship. 固定搭配：a chance encounter, a brief encounter
B(assumption)：语境句：You should never make an assumption about someone's background without knowing them. 固定搭配：make an assumption, on the assumption that
C(achievement)：语境句：Winning the championship was the greatest achievement of his sports career. 固定搭配：a sense of achievement, outstanding achievement
D(inspiration)：语境句：The beautiful scenery of the countryside served as an inspiration for her paintings. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：第一段说旅途中的偶遇往往无果而终，紧接着用“Yet”转折，说明“也有例外（exceptions）”，并引出后文作者遇到善良女士并被赠予鲜花的长久记忆。
questions.supplement:
A(alternatives)：语境句：If this plan fails, we need to have some viable alternatives ready. 固定搭配：provide alternatives, leave no alternative but to do
B(doubts)：语境句：I have some serious doubts about his ability to manage the project successfully. 固定搭配：cast doubt on, without a doubt
C(exceptions)：语境句：There are always exceptions to grammatical rules in the English language. 固定搭配：with the exception of, make an exception
D(rules)：语境句：You must follow the safety rules while working in the chemistry laboratory. 固定搭配：break the rules, against the rules

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：前面提到“Several ladies were taking pictures there”，其中一位拿着花在“摆姿势（posing）”。pose 意为“摆姿势”，常用于拍照场景。
questions.supplement:
A(running)：语境句：She came running down the stairs when she heard the good news. 固定搭配：go running, a running track
B(posing)：语境句：The models were posing for photographs in front of the historic building. 固定搭配：pose for a photo, strike a pose
C(painting)：语境句：He has been painting landscapes since he was a teenager. 固定搭配：oil painting, finish painting
D(performing)：语境句：The students will be performing a classic play at the end of the term. 固定搭配：perform a task, perform well

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：作者走上前夸赞花很漂亮，这位女士立刻“主动提出（offered）”把花给作者拍照。offer to do sth 意为“主动提出做某事”。易错点：agreed 表示同意别人的请求，但这里作者只是夸赞，并未提出要借花，是女士主动给的。
questions.supplement:
A(resolved)：语境句：The committee quickly resolved the conflict between the two departments. 固定搭配：resolve to do sth, resolve a problem
B(hesitated)：语境句：He hesitated for a moment before giving his final answer to the judge. 固定搭配：hesitate to do sth, without hesitating
C(offered)：语境句：She kindly offered to help me carry the heavy luggage to my room. 固定搭配：offer to do sth, offer sb sth
D(agreed)：语境句：After a long discussion, they finally agreed on the terms of the contract. 固定搭配：agree with sb, agree to do sth

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：拿到美丽的花拍照，作者感到很高兴，因此是“快乐地（joyfully）”笑了。
questions.supplement:
A(joyfully)：语境句：The children shouted joyfully when they saw the snow falling outside. 固定搭配：sing joyfully, smile joyfully
B(awkwardly)：语境句：He stood awkwardly in the corner, not knowing anyone at the party. 固定搭配：laugh awkwardly, stand awkwardly
C(nervously)：语境句：She waited nervously in the hallway before her job interview. 固定搭配：look nervously, wait nervously
D(secretly)：语境句：He was secretly hoping that she would invite him to her birthday party. 固定搭配：secretly admire, smile secretly

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这名陌生人的善意并未就此结束，她坚持让作者把花“留下（keep）”，直接送给了作者。
questions.supplement:
A(purchase)：语境句：They plan to purchase a new house in the suburbs next year. 固定搭配：purchase goods, a major purchase
B(keep)：语境句：You can keep the book as a gift if you really like it. 固定搭配：keep a promise, keep in touch
C(throw)：语境句：Please don't throw your rubbish on the ground in the park. 固定搭配：throw away, throw light on
D(deliver)：语境句：The postman will deliver the package to your office tomorrow morning. 固定搭配：deliver a speech, deliver a message

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这位女士之所以坚持送花，是因为她看出这束花“促成了/带来了（contributed to）”作者的快乐。contribute to 意为“有助于，促成”。
questions.supplement:
A(took away)：语境句：The police took away the suspect for further questioning. 固定搭配：take away, take one's breath away
B(put out)：语境句：The firefighters worked hard to put out the forest fire quickly. 固定搭配：put out a fire, put out an announcement
C(contributed to)：语境句：Regular exercise and a healthy diet contributed to his quick recovery. 固定搭配：contribute to, make a contribution to
D(stood for)：语境句：The dove has always stood for peace and harmony in many cultures. 固定搭配：stand for, stand out

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：人们通常从爱人那里收到花，而从陌生人那里收到花是一件非常“珍贵的（precious）”事。
questions.supplement:
A(stressful)：语境句：Moving to a new city and starting a new job can be a stressful experience. 固定搭配：a stressful situation, highly stressful
B(natural)：语境句：It is natural for parents to worry about their children's safety. 固定搭配：natural disaster, natural resources
C(odd)：语境句：It's a bit odd that he didn't call you on your birthday. 固定搭配：an odd number, against all odds
D(precious)：语境句：We should treasure every precious moment we spend with our families. 固定搭配：precious time, precious memories

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：虽然花最终会枯萎，但这件美好相遇的“记忆（memory）”会永远留在作者心中。呼应了上一段的“I still remember...”。
questions.supplement:
A(lesson)：语境句：His failure in the exam taught him a valuable lesson about the importance of hard work. 固定搭配：teach sb a lesson, learn a lesson
B(memory)：语境句：The sweet memory of her childhood still remains fresh in her mind. 固定搭配：in memory of, sweet memory
C(wisdom)：语境句：The old man shared his wisdom and life experiences with the young generation. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, words of wisdom
D(friendship)：语境句：Their strong friendship has lasted for over twenty years despite the distance. 固定搭配：build a friendship, long-lasting friendship

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这个小礼物成为了一个有力的“提醒物（reminder）”，提醒我们人们可以对他人表现出善意。reminder 指让人回忆起某事的事物。
questions.supplement:
A(shadow)：语境句：The tall building cast a long shadow across the quiet street in the late afternoon. 固定搭配：cast a shadow, in the shadow of
B(feature)：语境句：The unique architectural design is the most striking feature of this modern museum. 固定搭配：distinguishing feature, key feature
C(reminder)：语境句：The scar on his arm served as a constant reminder of the terrible accident. 固定搭配：serve as a reminder, a gentle reminder
D(purpose)：语境句：The main purpose of this meeting is to discuss the new marketing strategy. 固定搭配：on purpose, serve a purpose

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：此处指代人们可以向他人“展示/表达（show）”善意。show goodness to others 是符合逻辑的搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(award)：语境句：The school will award scholarships to students with outstanding academic records. 固定搭配：win an award, award a prize
B(introduce)：语境句：The manager will introduce the new employee to the rest of the team. 固定搭配：introduce sb to sb, introduce a new system
C(lend)：语境句：Could you lend me some money until I get paid next week? 固定搭配：lend sb a hand, lend money to sb
D(show)：语境句：We should always show respect to the elderly members of our community. 固定搭配：show respect for, show off

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：在那次旅行中，作者“擦肩而过（passed）”了很多人，但偏偏对这段经历记忆犹新。pass 表示经过、路过。
questions.supplement:
A(passed)：语境句：A few months passed before she finally received a reply to her letter. 固定搭配：pass by, pass away
B(supported)：语境句：My parents have always supported my decision to study art abroad. 固定搭配：support a family, strongly support
C(missed)：语境句：He missed the early train and was late for the important meeting. 固定搭配：miss the opportunity, miss the point
D(changed)：语境句：The invention of the internet has completely changed the way we communicate. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：送一束花是一个极其“简单的（simple）”举动，但它却能产生深远的影响（go a long way）。
questions.supplement:
A(brave)：语境句：It was very brave of him to rescue the child from the freezing river. 固定搭配：a brave attempt, brave the elements
B(simple)：语境句：Sometimes a simple apology is all it takes to mend a broken relationship. 固定搭配：pure and simple, simple truth
C(timely)：语境句：The timely arrival of the medical team saved the lives of many injured people. 固定搭配：in a timely manner, timely help
D(firm)：语境句：The manager took a firm stand on the issue of environmental protection. 固定搭配：firm belief, stand firm

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这些花让作者开心了一整天，每次回想起来，世界都似乎变得稍微“更明亮/更美好（brighter）”了一些。brighter 象征心情的愉悦与世界的温暖。
questions.supplement:
A(smaller)：语境句：With the development of transportation, the world seems to have become smaller. 固定搭配：a smaller amount, on a smaller scale
B(richer)：语境句：Reading good books can make our spiritual life much richer and more meaningful. 固定搭配：grow richer, richer in flavor
C(safer)：语境句：Installing security cameras can make the neighborhood a safer place to live. 固定搭配：safer environment, play it safe
D(brighter)：语境句：With a positive attitude, you will definitely have a brighter future. 固定搭配：a brighter future, look on the bright side

section_2_word_form.passage:
Huangshan-based lacquerware artisan Gan Erke has devoted his life to reviving (复兴) ancient lacquer techniques. His journey began at a local arts and crafts factory, [56] he noticed a gap between traditional Chinese lacquerware and modern global standards. This led him to revive the nearly lost rhinoceros leather (xi pi) lacquer technique, [57] (inspire) by a brief description in a Ming Dynasty text. After [58] (year) of experimentation, he successfully recreated and enhanced the technique by adding gold and increasing layers (层) from six to up to 102, [59] (achieve) greater depth and movement.
One of his [60] (influence) works is a round box with complex rhinoceros leather patterns. The surface is polished to [61] mirror-like finish, reflecting light beautifully. Another example is a tea container, to which Gan applied the same high standards, ensuring perfect polish both inside and out. Each piece takes over a year [62] (complete), as Gan aims for perfection.
Gan's works have earned [63] (recognize) at home and abroad. In 2011, one of his rhinoceros leather lacquered round boxes [64] (add) to the permanent collection at Beijing's Palace Museum. Major museums [65] the British Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Art in the US have also acquired his pieces.

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词是 a local arts and crafts factory，在后面的非限制性定语从句中作地点状语，故填关系副词 where。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：This is the exact place where we first met ten years ago. 固定搭配：where appropriate, know where one stands. 所给词 None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逻辑主语与 inspire 之间是被动关系（受到...启发），故使用过去分词 inspired 作状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(inspired)：语境句：Inspired by his teacher's words, he decided to apply for the top university. 固定搭配：be inspired by, feel inspired. 原词inspire其它变形：inspiration(n.), inspiring(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。表示“多年的实验”，year 前没有限定词，且结合句意应用复数形式 years，years of 为固定搭配。
questions.supplement: 正确形(years)：语境句：It took him several years of hard work to master the piano. 固定搭配：years of, over the years. 原词year其它变形：yearly(adj./adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。增加涂层层数，从而“实现了”更深层次的美感，这里表示自然而然的结果，用现在分词 achieving 作结果状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(achieving)：语境句：She has been fully devoted to achieving her long-term career goals. 固定搭配：achieve a goal, achieve success. 原词achieve其它变形：achievement(n.), achievable(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。修饰名词 works，需将动词/名词 influence 转换为形容词 influential（有影响力的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(influential)：语境句：He is one of the most influential figures in modern history. 固定搭配：highly influential, an influential role. 原词influence其它变形：influence(n./v.)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。finish 此处作单数可数名词，意为“表面光洁度/涂层”，泛指“一种如镜面般的光洁度”，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：The antique table has been restored to a perfect finish. 固定搭配：a lot of, as a result. 所给词 None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词及句型。固定句型 take + 时间 + to do sth. 意为“花费时间做某事”，故填动词不定式 to complete。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to complete)：语境句：It will take the construction workers another two months to complete the bridge. 固定搭配：take time to complete, complete with. 原词complete其它变形：completion(n.), completely(adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。在谓语动词 earned 之后作宾语，需要将动词 recognize 转换为名词形式 recognition（认可，赞誉）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(recognition)：语境句：His tireless efforts in charity have earned him widespread recognition. 固定搭配：earn recognition, beyond recognition. 原词recognize其它变形：recognizable(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查时态语态及主谓一致。主语是 one of his...boxes，为单数；时间状语 In 2011 决定了用一般过去时；且作品是被加入收藏的，故用被动语态 was added。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was added)：语境句：A new section was added to the final report to provide more details. 固定搭配：add to, add up. 原词add其它变形：addition(n.), additional(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。列举大英博物馆和美国大都会艺术博物馆作为主要博物馆的例子，表示“像...一样”或“包括...”，填 like（或 including 亦可）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(like)：语境句：She enjoys reading novels by classical authors like Charles Dickens and Jane Austen. 固定搭配：just like, something like. 所给词 None，无其它变形。
